messages:
Sam (support): FYI escalated ticket from Acme — they get a 403 on embeddings while same API key works for completions. User expects auth bug.
Acme Support (customer): hey, we used the same key for a few endpoints. embeddings fails with 403: `Unauthorized` in our SDK. can you check?
Sam (support): Thanks — grabbing logs now. Repro steps from customer:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-1","input":"hello"}'
```
Response: status 403, body: `{"error":"Unauthorized"}` and headers: `x-request-id: r123`, `x-plan: developer-free`.
Sam (support): I'm seeing `ENTITLEMENT_NOT_GRANTED` in backend logs tied to that request id — looks like feature gating, not token revocation. Leaving initial note for eng. @Jordan can you confirm?
Jordan (eng): Confirmed — entitlement service returns a 403 when a feature is not enabled for the account. We currently reuse the same 403 code for auth failures which is confusing. For this account `account_id=acme-112` plan=developer-free and `feature.embeddings` is not active. Log snippet: `ent-service: grant=false feature=embeddings account=acme-112 code=ENTITLEMENT_NOT_GRANTED`.
Priya (billing): Account acme-112 is on the free tier, embeddings are behind the paid plan (team+). We can enable a temporary trial for debugging if you want; otherwise customer must upgrade.
Megan (product): This is a UX problem — 403 should distinguish auth vs entitlement. Suggest adding an `error.code` like `ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED` and an `x-entitlement-detail` header with `required_plan=team` and a user-facing message that suggests upgrade or trial. Docs link should be included.
Jordan (eng): Agree. Quick mitigation: add `x-entitlement-reason: feature=embeddings;plan=developer-free` header and a clearer body: `{"error":"feature_not_enabled","message":"Embeddings are not included in your plan. Visit https://redwood.ai/pricing to upgrade or request a trial."}`. I'll prepare a hotfix for the service shim.
Sam (support): Notifying customer with suggested messaging and offering a 7d trial while eng patches.
Acme Support (customer): thanks — trial would be great. We couldn't tell if the key was wrong bc the SDK surfaces 403 only.
Jordan (eng): Hotfix PR submitted: `ent-shim#452` — adds `error.code=ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED`, `x-entitlement-detail` header, and a link to docs. Will route through QA and then prod.
Redwood Bot: Deploy queued: ent-shim v1.2.3 -> staging (ci/ent-shim #452).
Jordan (eng): Deployed to staging, tests passing. Payload example after fix:
```json
{
  "error": "ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED",
  "message": "Embeddings are not enabled for your account (plan=developer-free). Upgrade at https://redwood.ai/pricing or request a trial.",
  "request_action": "upgrade"
}
```
And header: `x-entitlement-detail: feature=embeddings;required_plan=team`
Priya (billing): I enabled a 7-day trial for acme-112 (trial_id=tr-9001). Please confirm customer can call embeddings now.
Sam (support): Sent updated response format to customer + trial info. Asked them to retry and paste request id.
Acme Support (customer): retried, succeeded — embeddings returned 200. Thanks for the quick turnaround! :tada:
Sam (support): Sweet. I'll update the KB: "403 vs entitlement gating — how to interpret responses" and mark ticket resolved.
Megan (product): We'll follow up to consider returning 402 for billing-required actions, but for now the clearer error code and header should cut down confusion.
Sam (support): Closing thread shortly; adding internal note to update SDK to surfacing `error.code` and `x-entitlement-detail`. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
